en.text:
<stasis/>Withering Blade hits and bounces grant 7.5% Melee Ability Energy. Additionally, the 1st and 3rd bounces spawn a Small <stasis/>Stasis Crystal.

Shattering a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal or <stasis/>Frozen Enemy with <stasis/>Withering Blade releases a spread of 3 <stasis/>Withering Blades.
